artifact_observations.reasoning: The grid-like texture on the lower grip area shows slight irregularity and 'melting' where the lines meet the edge of the casing, lacking the precise geometric uniformity of real molded plastic.
The spark wheel lacks distinct, sharp teeth. It appears as a blurred, fused metallic blob rather than a functional mechanical component with individual serrations.
The vertical edge of the lighter wavers slightly and does not maintain a perfectly straight line, suggesting minor geometric warping common in AI generation.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific subtype (disposable vs. refillable) and verify class alignment with high confidence.
To check for edge bleeding between the metallic finish and the white background, and to verify the continuity of the grip texture.
To closely inspect the mechanical plausibility of the ignition components which showed signs of fusion in initial scanning.

focus_areas: Mechanical integrity of the spark wheel (teeth definition)
Geometric regularity of the grip texture
Edge sharpness against the white background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the spark wheel. In AI images, this often renders as a smooth bump rather than a toothed wheel. Also, check if the grip texture 'wraps' correctly around the curvature of the lighter or if it flattens/distorts unnaturally.
